crossRefs.note: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself…
Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and…
If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead…
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship…
No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that…
We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in…
that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of…
For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you…
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world…
We love him, because he first loved us.

translations.web: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
translations.bsb: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
translations.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
translations.asv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.
